# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Use `AGENTS.md` as the cross-agent entrypoint and `README.md` as the repository router.

- Read the relevant repository files before making codebase-specific claims.
- Keep all `context_enginering` reads on the same requested ref.
- Do not copy presentation or project policy into this file; follow the authority files linked by `README.md`.
- Prefer minimal, reviewable changes and preserve existing authority boundaries.
- Before changing a rule, identify the file that owns that rule category.
- When validation exists, run or inspect the relevant audit/check before considering work complete.
- Never present an inference as verified project fact.
